---
title: "Introduction to data visualization with `ggplot2()`"
author: "Pablo E. Gutiérrez-Fonseca, PhD"
institute: "University of Puerto Rico"
date: last-modified
date-format: full
format:
  revealjs:
    slide-number: c/t
    show-slide-number: all
    logo: images/logo.png
    footer: <https://pegutierrezf.github.io/TropicalFreshwaterEcology/>
    css:
      - images/logo.css
      - images/pagetitle.css
      - images/slide.css
    html:
     embed-resources: true
    chalkboard: true
    title-slide-attributes:
      data-background-image: images/.png
      data-background-size: 5% 
      data-background-position: 900px 850px   # x y en px
      data-background-opacity: "0.8" 
    include-after: |
      <script>
        // Cuando la presentación se carga
        Reveal.on('ready', event => {
          // Si estamos en la primera slide (índice horizontal 0)
          if(event.indexh === 0) {
            const logo = document.querySelector('.slide-logo');
            if (logo) logo.style.display = 'none';
          }
        });

        // Cada vez que cambia de slide
        Reveal.on('slidechanged', event => {
          const logo = document.querySelector('.slide-logo');
          if (!logo) return;

          // Primera slide → ocultar logo
          if(event.indexh === 0) {
            logo.style.display = 'none';
          } 
          // Otras slides → mostrar logo
          else {
            logo.style.display = 'block';
          }
        });
      </script>
---

## Loading the dataset
```{r, echo=TRUE}
msleep <- read.csv("data/msleep.csv")
head(msleep)
```

## Basic scatterplot with regression line
- Some data
```{r}
#| output-location: column
ggplot(msleep)
```

## Basic scatterplot with regression line
- A set of variable mappings
```{r}
#| output-location: column
ggplot(msleep, 
       aes(x = log(bodywt), 
           y = sleep_total,  
           color = vore))
```


## Basic scatterplot with regression line
- A geom with arguments, or multiple geoms with arguments connected by +

```{r}
#| output-location: column
ggplot(msleep, 
       aes(x = log(bodywt), 
           y = sleep_total,  
           color = vore)) +
  geom_point()
```


## Basic scatterplot with regression line
- Add line of best fit

```{r}
#| output-location: column
ggplot(msleep, 
       aes(x = log(bodywt), 
           y = sleep_total,  
           color = vore)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", 
              se = FALSE) 
```


## Basic scatterplot with regression line
- Color by diet type (vore)

```{r}
#| output-location: column
ggplot(msleep, 
       aes(x = log(bodywt), 
           y = sleep_total,  
           color = vore)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "herbi" = "green",
      "carni" = "red",
      "omni"  = "blue",
      "insecti" = "orange",
      "unknown" = "gray"
    )
  )
```


## Basic scatterplot with regression line
- Define a formula for the regression equation

```{r}
#| output-location: column
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10 
my.formula = y ~ x
ggplot(msleep, 
       aes(x = log(bodywt), 
           y = sleep_total,  
           color = vore)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  stat_poly_eq(formula = my.formula,
               parse = TRUE, 
               label.y = "top",
               label.x = "left", 
               use_label(c("eq", "R2", "P"))) + 
    facet_wrap(. ~ vore, 
             ncol = 2,   
             scales = "free") +
  theme_bw(16)
```

## Basic scatterplot with regression line
- Define a formula for the regression equation

```{r}
#| output-location: column
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10 
my.formula = y ~ x
ggplot(msleep, 
       aes(x = log(bodywt), 
           y = sleep_total,  
           color = vore)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  stat_poly_eq(formula = my.formula,
               parse = TRUE, 
               label.y = "top",
               label.x = "left", 
               use_label(c("eq", "R2", "P"))) + 
    facet_grid(vore ~ order, 
             scales = "free") +
  theme_bw(16)
```



## Basic scatterplot with regression line
- A geom with arguments, or multiple geoms with arguments connected by +

```{r}
#| output-location: column
msleep2 <- msleep %>%
  mutate(logbodywt = log10(bodywt)) 
ggscatter(msleep2,
          x = "logbodywt", 
          y = "sleep_total",
          add = "reg.line",
          conf.int = TRUE,
          cor.coef = TRUE,
          cor.method = "pearson",
          xlab = "Log10 Body Weight",
          ylab = "Total Sleep (hours)")
```


## Basic scatterplot with regression line

```{r}
#| output-location: column
#| fig-width: 8.5
#| fig-height: 8 
msleep2 <- msleep %>%
  mutate(logbodywt = log10(bodywt)) 
ggstatsplot::ggscatterstats(msleep2,
          x = "logbodywt", 
          y = "sleep_total",
          add = "reg.line",
          conf.int = TRUE,
          cor.coef = TRUE,
          cor.method = "pearson",
          xlab = "Log10 Body Weight",
          ylab = "Total Sleep (hours)")
```
